preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.
The length of the permutation n must be between 1 and 100000 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in permutation)
preconditions.description: Each element of the permutation must be a distinct integer between 1 and n.
The sum of the lengths of all permutations across test cases must not exceed 100000.

postconditions.description: The number of subsequences k must be at least 1 and at most f(n), where f(n) is the minimum integer such that every permutation of length n can be partitioned into at most k monotonic subsequences.

postconditions.expression: all((all(subsequence[i] < subsequence[i+1] for i in range(len(subsequence)-1)) or all(subsequence[i] > subsequence[i+1] for i in range(len(subsequence)-1))) for subsequence in subsequences)
postconditions.description: Each subsequence must be either strictly increasing or strictly decreasing.
All elements of the permutation must be included in the subsequences without repetition.
